item.title: Planar Touched
item.description: Tieflings and Aasimar represent the rare physical manifestations of planar influence in Rathoria.

item.title: Humans
item.description: Humans are the most diverse race in Rathoria, both in culture and location.

item.title: Halflings
item.description: Halflings in Rathoria are defined by their connection to the land, split between pastoral agriculturalists and deep-woodland guardians.

item.title: Half-Elves
item.description: Despite the extreme difficulty of integrating into Elven society, Half-elves are more prevalent across Rathoria than demographic expectations would suggest.

item.title: Dragonborn
item.description: The Dragonborn of Rathoria are a localized and stable society, distinguished by their geographic concentration and the presence of innate magical abilities.

item.title: Dwarves
item.description: Dwarves are predictable most of them living in Caverns and cities built long before any mortal being remembers practicing traditions held for even longer than that.

item.title: Elves
item.description: The Elves are a sequestered and isolationist race, serving as the primary custodians of arcane knowledge in Rathoria.

item.title: Gnomes
item.description: Gnomes are a ubiquitous and highly assimilated race in Rathoria, found within nearly every society and people group across the continent.

item.title: Goliaths
item.description: Goliaths are a nomadic and physically formidable race inhabiting the highest reaches of the continent.

item.title: Welcome to Rathoria
item.description: Welcome to the public wiki for Rathoria. Select a document to begin reading.
